summary: Fixed the shared git-ls-files false-clean defect in check-record-versioning.sh and check-task-references.sh: PATH_SCOPE mode previously enumerated via a bare `git ls-files`, returning zero rows (and a silent clean verdict) for an on-disk-but-untracked file. Extracted a shared git-corpus-enum-lib.sh (tracked-plus-untracked union, gitignored content still excluded) and wired both lints to it, adding three stderr-only diagnostics so 'clean' and 'not examined' are always distinguishable. Added 10+22+17 passing fixture cases, corrected the inventory doc, redeployed (three passes, fixing a subject-resolution lint hit and a missing exec bit on this task's own new test file along the way), and triaged the one genuine new ADVISORY finding the fix surfaced (gate-cost-model.csv, fixed at its generator source).
